profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Mezmo
profile.summary:
Senior Software Developer, JavaScript application architect with 8+ years of experience creating high quality, large scale, data driven websites and JavaScript applications. Strong background building JavaScript tools, libraries and frameworks designed for high performance application development spanning from the server side to the client, with an emphasis on REST orientated APIs. I'm comfortable with application packaging and deployment automation using various continuous integration and delivery tools focused around linux containers ( mostly Docker ). 

Primary Languages:
===============
JavaScript since 2005
Node.js Since 2011
Python since 2006
Ruby 2009 - 2011

Rust

Adobe Creative Suite - Flash, Photoshop, Illustrator, FlexSDK

Specific Areas of interest: High performance JavaScript Frameworks and event driven application architectures. Building modular, reusable, cross-environment javascript libraries.

positions.title: Senior Architect
positions.description:
Help.com was an integrated communications platform. I drove the overall architecture of the backed services and databases. 

Primary data architecture design for backend services and APIs. Designed platform data integration. Designed + implemented Real time engine to handle changed data from primary data stores to power notifications via GraphQL. 

Key role in integrating the database layer with queuing systems and near real-time full text search systems.

Heavily involved in developing executable development plans, and feature requirements as a part of a highly performant kanban team.

Our Tech stack consisted of 

* PostgreSQL
* Elasticsearch
* RabbitMQ
* Node.js + GraphQL
* Redis

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer - Node.js
positions.description: Revolutionizing the customer service software space with Node.js

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
ThreadMeUp is an innovative technology company based in Chicago. It's industry changing platform powers all facets of bringing merchandise to life from supply chain to production, logistics and everything in between. ThreadMeUp empowers entrepreneurs, influencers, creatives, & organizations all over the world to create and sell custom merchandise.

Responsibilities include building Data driven API microservices, Build and deployment automation. Author reusable modules and packages for use with in the company tech teams.

Most of my day is spent building things with Node.js

Our Stack includes:

* CoreOS Linux & Docker
* Nodejs
* PHP
* ReactJS
* MySQL
* Bamboo
* Redis
* AWS ( SQS, EC2, S3, RDS ) 

Our APIs are powered by Tastypie

positions.title: Senior Node.js Engineer
positions.description: Primary focus in Node.js REST Applications built around the M.E.A.N Stack. Establishing code standards and best practices. Implement framework level code for large scale e-commerce platform with an emphasis on robust, re-usable code.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Corvisa Services is the technology arm of Novation, a company that acquires young
companies and gives them the means and experience to flourish. Corvisa handles
all software development and infrastructure needs any of the acquired companies
may have - focusing primarily on ReSTful web based applications. My primary
responsibilities included architecture design, and implementation of reusable & stand
alone javascript frameworks and tools for all of Novations companies to make use of.
I also established best practices and standard procedures for team members to follow
to ensure code quality

We focus on distributed CRM and TelCom solutions with immersive single page JavaScript applications using HTML5, CSS3, ExtJS and or internal JavaScript tools / libraries.

I spend most of every day writing JavaScript - Server Side and Client Side.

positions.title: Front End Development Team Lead
positions.description: Work on the collective appraisal management Javascript properties of Corvisa and streetlinks, ranging from the desktop, to mobile applications to complex marketing sites

positions.title: Lead Graphic Designer
positions.description: Primarily responsible for design and overall direction of league's short run print magazine, Smashmouth. I designed multiple issues, cover to cover. Also responsible for ensuring quality print runs and sponsorship advert placements.

positions.title: Editor in Chief - Smashmouth Magazine
positions.description: Responsible for overall direction of the magazine's content and quality. Ranging from content aggregation, creation, as well as head of design and product. Also responsible for final print and distribution of the magazine.

positions.title: Mobile Web Application Developer
positions.description:
Built a single page mobile application allowing users to share and study content created on the main study blue website.

Main features included:
integrated, faceted content search with autocomplete
Full featured interactive Flash card application
Full featured Quiz application

projects.title: Skyring
projects.description: Reliable, distributed timers as a service built on Node.js

projects.title: Node Allstar
projects.description: A re-realization of the first web application I created built with node.js on top of the megadoomer application suite
